Visit note | 2025-07-05 12:00 PM | Dr. Rokeya Khatun, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Ishrat Matubbar, 19, female. Miss Matubbar attends for review regarding her skin and unwanted hair. She mentions she has had no periods for six months with no acne or weight gain. She works as a garment factory worker and noticed these issues after a friend in Motijheel suggested testing. She has Hypothyroidism. On examination: BMI 26.1, BP 126/81 mmHg, pulse 74 bpm, weight 78 kg. Her chest is clear and abdomen is soft. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued today. She was advised to aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up in 3 months.

Visit note | 2025-07-05 12:30 PM | Dr. Shamima Nasrin, Ophthalmology | Patient: Jesmin Patwary, 64, female. Mrs. Patwary presents reporting a red eye, sticky yellow discharge, and eyelids stuck together in the morning. She states that the trouble started during an outbreak at an office in Faridpur. She is a madrasa teacher and has Essential hypertension. She denies severe eye pain or sudden vision loss. On examination: visual acuity 6/6 in the left eye, BP 152/95 mmHg, pulse 74 bpm, weight 93 kg. Conjunctival injection and mucopurulent discharge are visible. Assessment: Bacterial conjunctivitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to wash her hands often, do not share towels, and stay away from work for two days. Follow-up in 1 week if not better.
